gp.heading: Cost of Revenues and Gross Profit
gp.text:
Cost of finished cannabis inventory sold for the three months ended March 31, 2026 was $5,198,024, an increase of $1,411,588 or approximately 37% as compared to $3,786,436 for the three months ended March 31, 2025. Cost of revenues grew at a rate faster than the rate of revenue growth (28%), largely due to mix and higher operating lease costs included in cost of sales.

tax.text: Income tax expense for the three months ended March 31, 2026 was $516,871, with a corresponding effective tax rate of approximately 30.5%, as compared to $631,310 and an effective tax rate of approximately (46%) (on pre-tax income) for the three months ended March 31, 2025. da.text: In addition to financial measures presented in accordance with U.S. GAAP, management uses non-GAAP financial measures, including EBITDA and Adjusted EBITDA, to evaluate operating performance, for financial and operational decision-making, planning and forecasting purposes, and to compare results across accounting periods. EBITDA is defined as net income or loss before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization, further adjusted to remove transaction costs, share-based compensation expense, accretion expense, gain or loss on derecognition of derivative liabilities, and other non-cash items or items not representative of operational performance. Adjusted EBITDA is EBITDA further adjusted for the impact of significant or unusual transactions, including, where applicable, costs associated with business acquisitions and pre-opening operating costs of new production locations.

opex.heading: Operating Expenses
opex.text:
Total operating expenses for the three months ended September 30, 2026 were $5,749,913, an increase of $2,359,800 or approximately 70% as compared to $3,390,113 for the three months ended September 30, 2025. For the nine months ended September 30, 2026, total operating expenses were $14,141,213, an increase of $3,554,828 or approximately 34% as compared to $10,586,385 for the nine months ended September 30, 2025.

The increase for the three months ended September 30, 2026 was driven principally by higher general and administrative expenses ($5,332,245 for the three months ended September 30, 2026 as compared to $2,964,469 in the prior-year quarter). The year-to-date increase was driven principally by higher general and administrative expenses ($13,262,652 for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 as compared to $8,175,095 for the prior-year period), for the same reasons.

The net losses in 2026 include the $5,030,332 loss on the acquisition of Rogue EBC. Net loss attributable to shareholders was $9,078,320 for the current quarter and $13,473,373 year-to-date. Net income attributable to non-controlling interests was $1,279,574 and $1,980,212, respectively, and net loss attributable to the redeemable non-controlling interest was $1,089,393 for both periods. Net income attributable to the non-controlling interest in GRMA equals the 15% preferred return on the GRMA Units. GRNY’s net loss is attributed using the hypothetical liquidation at book value method and, because the holder of the GRNY Preferred Units contributed all of GRNY’s capital, was attributed entirely to the redeemable non-controlling interest. For further discussion, see Notes 3 and 23 to the unaudited condensed consolidated financial statements.

ocf.heading: Operating Activities
ocf.text: Net cash provided by operating activities was $5,924,360 for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, as compared to net cash used in operating activities of $15,060 for the nine months ended September 30, 2025. The current-period result reflects $2,745,833 of tenant improvement allowance proceeds for the Fridley, Minnesota facility and approximately $4,465,705 of favorable changes in non-cash working capital, principally increases in the uncertain tax position liability ($3,710,229), accounts payable and accrued liabilities ($3,428,584) and income tax payable ($429,435), partially offset by increases in prepaid expenses ($1,787,699, including the deposit paid toward the consideration for the proposed acquisition of PCNY), accounts receivable ($986,692) and inventory ($328,152).

da.text: In addition to financial measures presented in accordance with U.S. GAAP, management uses non-GAAP financial measures, including EBITDA and Adjusted EBITDA, to evaluate operating performance, for financial and operational decision-making, planning and forecasting purposes, and to compare results across accounting periods. EBITDA is defined as net income or loss before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization, further adjusted to remove transaction costs, share-based compensation expense, accretion expense, gain or loss on derecognition of derivative liabilities, impairment of intangible assets, losses on acquisitions, and other non-cash items or items not representative of operational performance. Adjusted EBITDA is EBITDA further adjusted for the impact of significant or unusual transactions, including, where applicable, costs associated with business acquisitions and pre-opening operating costs of new production locations.

wc.heading: Working Capital
wc.text:
At September 30, 2026 and December 31, 2025, our working capital was approximately $17,551,070 and $16,590,979, respectively, calculated as current assets less current liabilities (excluding the derivative liability and the warrant liabilities, in each case representing non-cash fair value items). Cash and cash equivalents were $16,602,268 at September 30, 2026 as compared to $11,371,834 at December 31, 2025. Total current assets were $30,740,946 at September 30, 2026 as compared to $22,178,714 at December 31, 2025. The increase reflects higher cash, and higher prepaid expenses and other current assets ($2,489,611 compared to $563,912), which include a $1,515,580 deposit paid toward the consideration for the proposed acquisition of PCNY.

Total current liabilities were $14,360,438 at September 30, 2026 as compared to $5,724,776 at December 31, 2025. The increase reflects:

We expect significant ongoing fluctuations in working capital over time as we continue to invest in expansion of cultivation capacity at ABCO Garden State, LLC and the build-out of operations in Illinois, Minnesota and New York. We have historically been able to meet commitments, modify debt maturities, and raise new financing as required to respond to changes in our liquidity position, although there is no guarantee we will be able to do so in the future.

net sales.heading: Total Revenues
net sales.text: All revenue for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026 and 2025 was earned from product sales of cannabis flower and pre-roll products. Total revenue for the three months ended September 30, 2026 was $11,019,038, an increase of $2,504,770 or approximately 29% as compared to $8,514,268 for the three months ended September 30, 2025. For the nine months ended September 30, 2026, total revenue was $31,448,533, an increase of $7,774,095 or approximately 33% as compared to $23,674,438 for the nine months ended September 30, 2025. The increase in revenue was driven primarily by continued growth at our New Jersey operations, which contributed $4,863,295 to revenue in the current quarter (as compared to $3,378,777 in the prior-year quarter) and $12,648,361 for the year-to-date period (as compared to $7,806,451 in the prior-year period), together with year-over-year growth in the Oregon and Michigan operations. Michigan revenue includes Michigan cannabis excise taxes, which took effect January 1, 2026, of approximately $346,678 and $1,094,920 for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026, respectively; the corresponding expense is included in general and administrative expenses. Revenue decreased compared to the second quarter of 2026 ($11,273,837), mainly because of lower Oregon and Michigan sales, partially offset by higher New Jersey sales.

intro.text: In this Annual Report on Form 10-K (this “Annual Report”), unless context otherwise requires, references to “we,” “us,” “our,” “Grown Rogue” or the “Company” refer to Grown Rogue International Inc., a Canadian corporation, and each of its subsidiaries, taken together. We were incorporated on September 22, 1978 as Bonanza Red Lake Explorations Inc. under the Business Corporations Act (Ontario) . Until 2016, we operated predominantly as a mining and energy company. During that period we also underwent several name changes, from Bonanza Red Lake Explorations Inc. to Eugenic Corp; from Eugenic Corp to Eagleford Energy Inc.; and from Eagleford Energy Inc. to Eagleford Energy Corp.

Total consideration was $2,431,831, comprising a $500,000 cash advance, $909,401 representing the combined initial present value of the deferred payments, and the $1,022,430 carrying amount of the Company’s previously held investment in Rogue EBC.
The Company accounted for its interest in Rogue EBC, LLC using the equity method until July 14, 2026, when it acquired the remaining membership interest and began consolidating Rogue EBC (Note 4).

These were partially offset by unrealized gains on the interest rate swaps of $131,671 in the current quarter and $280,054 year-to-date (prior-year periods – losses of $24,242 and $51,896), an unrealized gain on the warrant liability of $369,103 year-to-date (current quarter – loss of $64,444), higher interest income of $46,264 in the current quarter and $192,807 year-to-date (as compared to $36,736 and $109,010, respectively), and a lower loss on the equity investment in Rogue EBC of $8,180 in the current quarter and $301,430 year-to-date (as compared to $75,733 and $344,153), as Rogue EBC was consolidated from July 14, 2026.
Previously, the Company accounted for its interest in Rogue EBC as a joint venture using the equity method.
